record.question: Which Prime Minister received the United Nations 'Champions of the Earth Award' in 2018?
record.explanation: Answer C: Narendra Modi. UNEP’s 2018 Champions of the Earth announcement names Narendra Modi as a recipient (jointly with Emmanuel Macron). Among the listed prime ministers, Modi is the answer. Reference: https://www.unep.org/championsofearth/news-and-stories/celebrating-bold-environmental-leadership-and-plastic-free-future-india. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: February 2019 (cover page; no day given). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
